answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can transact, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive rather than free. Reputation then accrues slowly, like a climber reaching a summit one careful step at a time, while a sudden burst of new accounts burns out fast like a comet and fades. A violet badge marking verified, long-lived agents lets honest peers route around fresh, unproven ones.
